OP, as a fellow Arch/Manjaro user, I would advise you to become familiar with Yaourt.

It will be extrenely rare for you to be unable to find the package you want on at least one of these managers. Yaourt is pre installed and configured on Manjaro too.
Please do not recommend yaourt and see https://wiki.archlinux.org/index.php/AUR_helpers for more info. Personally I use pacaur

You have a few options.

You actually can install dpkg in arch via the AUR: https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/dpkg/ Whereupon the dpkg -i /path/to/file.deb will work

Alternatively, if you can use a tool called deb2targz https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/deb2targz/

What that will do is will turn your .deb file into a .tar.gz package whereupon you can use Arch's package manger (pacman) to do: pacman -U /path/to/file.tar.gz
